The museum campus is composed of two sections. The original heart of the campus is located on both sides of Church Street, and between Church and Reservoir Streets, just north of Main Street (United States Route 1).[3]  In addition to these buildings, the museum has expanded into three attached buildings on the north side of Main Street west of Knox Bros. Ave..
